resolution.question: Will Ostara Foods' support desk resolve, or at least substantively reply to, customer Hana Suzuki's complaint about a moldy delivery within its advertised 24-hour window?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Ostara Foods' support desk sent a substantive reply (not an automated acknowledgment) to Hana Suzuki before 2026-08-20T13:00:00+09:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
